what: an iron felling axe: a heavy broad head, the blade flaring strongly to a wide, gently curved cutting edge about 11 px long, a solid flat poll for hammering; bright warm-silver iron with a near-white bevel along the cutting edge and a soft warm-grey outline, a gold collar where head meets handle, the long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel. Orientation, exactly like a real axe and Minecraft's: the handle runs straight from the bottom-left corner up to near the top-right. At the handle's top end the head sits crosswise to it. The blade sticks out toward the UPPER LEFT of the handle's end, and its cutting edge is a line PARALLEL to the handle (running from the upper right down toward the lower left), on the blade's far side from the handle. On the other side, toward the lower right, a short blunt poll. Never a vertical edge, never an edge across the handle. Keep 1-2 px of margin from the canvas sides.
